annotation.method: Manual. Frames were extracted, cropped around the disc and magnified, and the centre read off by eye; positions were then converted back into the 640x360 frame space.

notes: The disc is in hand for roughly the first 225 frames. It is only airborne between about frame 228 and frame 270.
The player's shirt is bright yellow and the disc is orange; the background is dry yellow grass. Hue alone separates them poorly, which is what makes this clip a useful test rather than an easy one.

The camera pans right hard just after release, so the disc's horizontal motion in frame is dominated by camera motion rather than by the throw. Its vertical motion still shows a real arc: it rises then falls.
There is a scene cut at roughly frame 305 to an unrelated shot. Nothing should be tracked across it.

flightWindow.note: Every frame in this range is committed, so tracking can be exercised at the real frame rate. Only every fourth frame is annotated; the tracker runs over all of them and is scored on the annotated ones.
